tvs.title_bl1_about: Eyelash extensions – beauty and comfort every day
tvs.text_bl1_about:
Applying mascara every day and taking it off every night can get tiring. Often there just isn't enough time for it in the morning or enough energy left in the evening.
Lash extensions take these steps out of your daily routine, freeing up time for other things that matter just as much. A gorgeous gaze becomes your go-to beauty accessory at any time of day or night, whatever the weather and whatever the occasion. Full, beautifully curled lashes suit both casual and elegant looks and give you confidence in any situation: even in the rain, your eyes will look fresh, with no smudges of black mascara.
tvs.text-1-bl3: No more spending money on mascara and trying to coat your lashes without clumps or stuck-together hairs. Volume or classic lash extensions – your eyes look flawless even when you've just woken up.
tvs.text-2-bl3: Well-placed volume makes your eyes look visually larger, and if you like, you can create a fox-eye or almond-eye effect.
tvs.text-3-bl3: Your lashes look natural, beautiful and captivating – you'll always know you look stunning, even without makeup.

tvs.title-bl-seo: Why are eyelash extensions so popular?
tvs.text-bl-seo: Unlike strip lashes, eyelash extensions look very natural. They blend in with your own lashes, adding volume, length and a beautiful curl. Well-done extensions last up to 5–6 weeks, and throughout that time you don't need mascara or eyeliner – your eyes look expressive and attractive every day and in any situation. All you need is a quick mini touch-up as your natural lashes shed, which is a completely normal process. It's much cheaper, more pleasant and simpler than putting on and taking off eye makeup every day.
tvs.text-bl-seo-2:
Benefits of classic eyelash extensions

Eyelash extensions give you more than just a beautiful look – they come with plenty of other advantages:

  • Safe for your natural lashes. Mascara and other decorative cosmetics can damage natural lashes, thin them out and even make them fall out. With extensions made from quality materials and a hypoallergenic adhesive, your lashes look well-groomed without being harmed and get a chance to "rest" from the negative effects of cosmetics.
  • Confidence. When you know your eyes look as if a makeup artist had just done them, you feel more confident and in a better mood. What's more, there's nothing to worry about: artificial lashes won't let you down the way mascara does when it clumps or runs.
  • Time savings. You gain an extra 10–20 minutes every morning and evening for other enjoyable things.
  • A wide variety of styles. Extensions in various materials, in any technique and style – all to the client's taste and suited to her facial features. Your eyes can dramatically transform your whole look.
  • Camouflages signs of aging. Full lashes draw attention away from fine lines and make your gaze look fresher.

How are classic eyelash extensions applied at the LBar salon in Bucharest?

The procedure is fairly complex and meticulous, and it requires professional training and a solid command of every technique. It goes like this:

  • Preparation. The lash stylist carefully removes your eye makeup and cleanses the skin around the eyes with a cleansing foam or micellar water. The cleanser is oil-free so that it doesn't interfere with applying the extensions.
  • Isolating the lower eyelid and lower lash line. Eye patches are used for this. They don't cause any discomfort or bother you.
  • Cleansing. Using a special product, the specialist removes excess oil from the skin to ensure a strong adhesive bond.
  • Applying the primer. It cleanses the lashes and opens the cuticle for a secure hold. The stylist applies a small amount of product with a micro brush.
  • Preparing the lashes. They are placed on a palette and sorted by length and curl.
  • Lash extension. This is done according to the chosen technique and style. At the end, the stylist checks that the extensions are firmly attached.
  • Applying the sealant. The product is applied to the root area to form a protective film that lasts for three days.
  • Combing the lashes. This sets them in the desired direction. Depending on the chosen technique, the stylist uses a silicone or nylon brush.
  • Removing the patches and showing the client the result. The procedure is now complete, and you can enjoy the result.

Our lash stylist will advise you on how to care for your lashes and when you'll need a touch-up.

About touch-ups

Touch-ups are done every 2–4 weeks, depending on the type and condition of your natural lashes. A single eyelash has a "life cycle" of about 6–8 weeks. At the time of the extension, each lash is at a different stage: some have just grown in, others are midway through their life cycle, and others are about to fall out. It's normal for a few lashes to shed soon after the procedure – this won't affect the overall look, especially with 2D, 3D and higher-volume lash extensions. A touch-up is only needed once a significant number of lashes have fallen out. During it, the specialist fills the gaps with new artificial lashes and partially replaces the remaining extensions. A lash extension touch-up in Bucharest by our stylist gives you a unique effect for up to 8 weeks.

Aftercare for eyelash extensions

To keep your lash extensions looking lush for as long as possible, proper aftercare is essential:

  • Don't use oily-textured cosmetics around the eyes. This applies to all cosmetics except powder products.
  • Don't use patches or other products for the under-eye area and eyelids.
  • Don't apply mascara to your lashes.
  • Don't rub your eyes, as you can break or even pull out your natural lashes – and the extensions along with them.
  • Use water-based, oil-free makeup removers – oil can damage the lash adhesive.
  • Cleanse your eyes once a day with an eye-cleansing solution to remove makeup residue, dust and excess sebum. Don't skip this step: sebum and makeup products can break down the adhesive, and the extensions will fall out too soon. Don't be afraid of water – it doesn't affect the materials in any way.

Classic eyelash extensions – the choice of modern women

The first false eyelashes appeared in 1916, thanks to film director D. W. Griffith. Over the more than 100 years since, they have undergone major transformations, and the technology has advanced considerably. Today, high-quality materials and clear and black hypoallergenic adhesives are used, along with a range of techniques and combinations – all to create a look that is as natural as possible, yet expressive and attractive. The most important thing is to combine your wishes with what perfectly suits your features. The specialists at LBar studio will help you find the best solution and make your look brighter, more elegant and more attractive.

migx_questions.questions-title: What types of eyelash extensions are there?
migx_questions.questions-text:
In general, they differ in three ways:

  • Length. It ranges from 4 to 20 mm. Short extensions are applied to the lower lid, while the rest are attached to different areas of the upper lid. Our clients usually prefer a maximum length of 12–13 mm.
  • Thickness. It ranges from 0.03 to 0.25 mm. The thinnest are used for 6D and higher-volume lashes, and the thickest for the most natural effect. We recommend a thickness of 0.07 mm for 3D lashes and 0.1–0.12 mm for 2D lashes. Classic eyelash extensions are made with 0.15 mm fibers.
  • Curl. It can be used to visually correct the shape and size of the eyes. There are eight types of curl, but only four are commonly used.

migx_questions.questions-title: Which eyelash extension techniques are used at the LBar salon?
migx_questions.questions-text:
Our lash stylist is a true professional who masterfully performs every eyelash extension technique:

  • classic lashes – one artificial lash is applied to each natural lash. They subtly enhance the intensity of your gaze and suit young women.
  • 2D lashes – two extensions are applied to one natural lash. They look natural and add expressiveness to the eyes.
  • 3D lashes – a fan of 3 extensions is applied to a natural lash. They add volume and density – an excellent option for ambitious women.
  • 3D–6D lashes – a fan of 3–6 extensions is applied the same way. They suit those with sparse natural lashes and give density and pronounced volume.
  • 6D–12D lashes – the same lash-by-lash method, except that a fan of 6–12 extensions is applied. They make your gaze expressive and double the volume.

The price of eyelash extensions varies depending on the technique you choose.

migx_questions.questions-title: How long does the procedure take?
migx_questions.questions-text: Depending on the technique, the procedure can take from 1 to 3 hours. The higher the lash density, the longer the specialist needs to work. Removing lash extensions takes 15–30 minutes.

migx_questions.questions-title: How many extensions are applied to each eye?
migx_questions.questions-text: The number of lashes used depends on the density of your natural lashes and the volume you want. Each eye may need anywhere from 100 to 750 lash extensions.

migx_questions.questions-title: Will people notice I'm wearing lash extensions?
migx_questions.questions-text: The lash stylist aims to create the most natural effect possible by choosing a medium length and a moderate number of lashes. People around you will notice the change, but visually the extensions will be impossible to tell apart from your natural lashes. If you want a doll-eye effect, the specialist's work will be visible, but the lashes won't look artificial – they'll look authentic and natural.
